summary: Nomura Holdings filed a 6-K with its Japanese share buyback report for April 2026. The board authorized on January 30, 2026 a repurchase of up to 100 million shares for up to ¥60 billion, running through September 30, 2026. During April, Nomura repurchased 14,309,600 shares for ¥18.5 billion, bringing cumulative repurchases to 46,861,200 shares for ¥60 billion (100% of authorized amount). The program excludes ten business days after quarterly results. Treasury shares were also disposed for equity compensation (RSUs). This is an issuer capital return via open-market buyback, not a tender offer.
